content.title: Airline stocks slip on continued delays, Beyond Meat stock falls
content.description:
Josh Lipton recaps three of the top stories on Wall Street as part of Yahoo Finance's Market Minute.

Nvidia (NVDA) and CoreWeave (CRWV) are some of the tech stocks in the red during Tuesday's session.

Airline stocks, like Delta Air Lines (DAL), United (UAL), and American (AAL), are under pressure as flight delays are expected to continue beyond the government shutdown.

Beyond Meat (BYND) stock tumbles after issuing a weak outlook.

Stay up to date on the latest market action, minute-by-minute, with Yahoo Finance's Market Minute.

content.title: How long until US shutdown flight chaos returns back to normal?
content.description:
The US Senate voted 60-to-40 on a procedural measure to advance a bill that could end the government shutdown to the House.

Bloomberg Intelligence senior aerospace defense and airlines industry analyst George Ferguson comes on Market Catalysts to speak more about the pressure that major airline operators have felt under what has now been the longest-ever US government shutdown.

content.title: Republicans Reject Shutdown Offer as Travel, Food Aid Delays Hit
content.summary: Senate Democratic leader Chuck Schumer billed his offer as a “simple compromise” that could pass the chamber “within a few hours.”  Republican leader John Thune dismissed the offer as a “nonstarter” but told reporters at the Capitol that it indicated “progress.”  “They’re feeling the heat,” Thune said.
